definitions.explanation: A person one knows but is not necessarily close friends with. Less intimate than a friend but more than a stranger.

examples.japanese: {街|まち}で{知人|ちじん}に{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I ran into an acquaintance in town.

examples.japanese: {知人|ちじん}の{紹介|しょうかい}で{仕事|しごと}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a job through an acquaintance's introduction.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{友人|ゆうじん}というより{知人|ちじん}だ。
examples.english: He's more of an acquaintance than a friend.

notes:
RELATIONSHIP SPECTRUM:
- {他人|たにん} (stranger)
- {知人|ちじん} (acquaintance)
- {知り合い|しりあい} (acquaintance - less formal)
- {友人|ゆうじん}/{友達|ともだち} (friend)
- {親友|しんゆう} (close friend)

CONTRAST:
- {知人|ちじん} - slightly formal; often used in written language
- {知り合い|しりあい} - casual; more common in spoken language

COMMON USAGE:
- {知人|ちじん}に{紹介|しょうかい}してもらう (to be introduced by an acquaintance)
- {知人|ちじん}を{通|とお}じて (through an acquaintance)
